agent_explanation: High-speed (~45 m/s) head-on hit on left face of thin wall (h=0.28, x=7.038). Contact is detected (distance goes +0.098 at step16 to -0.040 at step17 to -0.178 at step18) but velocity vx stays exactly 45.067 across steps 15-18, so neither impulse nor positional correction acts. Penetration then grows by the full per-step displacement (~0.138) and exceeds the 0.15 limit at step 18. Likely cause: box-circle solver fails to resolve face contacts when wall thickness is much smaller than diameter combined with large per-step momentum, or substepped correction is capped too small.
